faq_concepts.q: How to edit, delete, undo & redo in the Flow Canvas?
faq_concepts.a: Click any node or connection edge to select it; a floating 🗑 delete button will appear immediately (or press Delete / Backspace). To undo or redo, click ↶ ↷ buttons at the top-left of the canvas or use ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z) and ⇧⌘Z (Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y).
Yes. Start local Ollama in Settings -> AI Models and download open-source models (e.g., Qwen, Llama). No external API keys required.

faq_concepts.q: How to verify financial report sources and original filings?
faq_concepts.a: The platform automatically retrieves statutory disclosure filings from the official CNINFO portal. Titles with ↗ icons can be clicked to open official filings in a new tab. If a PDF button is available, you can directly open original PDF filings to cross-examine AI financial reasoning.
